# EDH
Everything DeepSeek Harness — one plugin, one master switch, a feature per row.
## Features
| Feature | What it does |

| `retry` | Retries a failed model request inside the same turn, with no attempt limit |
| `edit` |
Adds a pencil to every user message: forks the Session just before it and puts the text back in the

composer |
| `btw` | `/btw` and `/side` open a side chat: a fork of this conversation, shown beside

it in the right-hand pane |
| `export` | Downloads the Session as a Markdown document |
| `update` |
Updates EDH itself from its published repo, from EDH's page in Plugin Manager, and reloads the new

browser half in place |
| `mcp` | Connects MCP servers from a settings page — no Cordis config — and

gives their tools to the model as it goes |
| `remote` | Opens the same Web GUI on a phone over the

LAN, behind a login page and a username and password you set |
| `usage` | Shows where your tokens

went: totals, per model and per day across every Session, with streaks and peaks |
| `mobile` | Serv
es the web app manifest, so a phone can add the GUI to its home screen and open it without browser c

hrome |
| `notify` | Serves a curated few of the real Windows sound files, so a notification plays t

he sound you already know |
| `search` | Full-text search across every stored Session, from a Ctrl+K

palette — indexed in the background, answered from memory |
| `skills` | Lists the skills the agent

can actually see, split into the ones this workspace adds and the ones the Harness brings |
| `ask`
| Answers "which conversation is about X?" by asking the model over the search index — two calls, a

nd no Session is created |
| `queue` | Enter on an empty composer sends the first queued message as
a steer, through the harness's own queue action |
A switch in the conversation header turns them all on or off together.
## Install

EDH is a Harness bundle: the package carries a `dsh.bundle.patch`, which adds its Loader
rows. Insta

ll it like any other bundle — `"@moreweb/edh": "link:/path/to/EDH"`, or the
packed tarball — then en
able the rows you want in Plugin Manager.
